info.name: Zivdah API — Admin, User & Vendor
info.description:
All zivdah-api microservice endpoints, routed through the API gateway
(http://localhost:8001), covering the three roles enforced by the backend:
ADMIN, USER (customer) and VENDOR (merchant).

Start with folder "0. Bootstrap" to register/login and populate
{{adminToken}} / {{userToken}} / {{vendorToken}} automatically.

Requests flagged with ⚠ in their description hit endpoints where the live
backend currently has weaker auth than you might expect (missing
@PreAuthorize / ownership checks, or an unintentionally public route) —
they are included as-is to match the real API, not as a recommendation.

item.name: 0. Bootstrap — Register & Login
item.description:
Run these first. Login/OTP-verify requests auto-capture the JWT + user id into
collection variables (adminToken/userToken/vendorToken) via a test script, based
on the role in the response — every other request in this collection already
references those variables.

ADMIN accounts cannot self-register (blocked in AuthServiceImpl.register()).
Seed one directly in the DB (role='ADMIN'), or register a normal user then have
an existing admin call "Update User Role -> ADMIN" below to promote them.

item.description: Base path: /restful/v1/api/products. Category enum: VEGETABLE | FRUIT | MILK | PULSE | GROCERY.

request.description:
Vendor-created products are auto-tagged with the caller's vendorId; admin-created products are platform-owned (vendorId=null).

Requires role: ADMIN or VENDOR. Vendors are restricted to their own vendorId/records (403 otherwise); Admins can access any. Using {{vendorToken}} by default — swap to {{adminToken}} to test as admin.

item.name: 5. Category Service
item.description: Base path: /restful/v1/api/category. Additive normalized category lookup (distinct from the fixed ProductCategory enum used on products.category) — supports nesting via parentId.

request.description:
Public — returns only active=true categories.

No authentication required.
Requires role: ADMIN.
No authentication required.

slug is optional — auto-generated from name (and de-duplicated with -2, -3, ... on collision) when omitted. parentId nests this as a subcategory of another category.

Requires role: ADMIN.

Slug stays stable across updates unless you explicitly pass a new one here.

Requires role: ADMIN.

  "name": "Organic Vegetables & Herbs",
  "slug": null,
  "parentId": null,
  "imageUrl": null,
  "active": true
}
